') center center/contain no-repeat;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;flex:none}
.hero-titles{min-width:0}.brand-banner h1{font-size:clamp(25px,3.3vw,42px);line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:.105em;margin:6px 0;text-shadow:0 3px 12px #0008}

.global-dock{justify-content:flex-end;margin:0 0 16px}.global-dock details{background:rgba(16,36,52,.8);border-color:#50657a;min-width:0}.global-dock summary{padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px}.global-dock .primary-share-actions button{font-size:12px}
.setup-card{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto 24px;padding:27px 31px 22px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(27,48,66,.96),rgba(13,30,45,.98));border-color:#64707c;box-shadow:0 24px 55px #0003}

.setup-header{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:25px}.setup-header h2{font-size:clamp(23px,2.5vw,30px);letter-spacing:.01em;font-weight:680;color:#f7f3eb;margin:7px 0 6px}.setup-header p{font-size:12px;color:#b5c2ce;margin:0}.setup-status{white-space:nowrap;color:#b7d6c5;border:1px solid #507d6a;background:#203e3a;border-radius:24px;padding:7px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.setup-simple-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px 20px}.setup-simple-fields .field:first-child{grid-column:1/2}.setup-simple-fields .field:nth-child(2){grid-column:2/3}.setup-simple-fields .field:nth-child(3){grid-column:1/2}.setup-simple-fields .field:nth-child(4){grid-column:2/3}.setup-card .field label,.setup-card .courts-field>label{font-size:11px;color:#d2b78e;letter-spacing:.035em;margin-bottom:9px;font-weight:680}.setup-card input,.setup-card select{min-height:48px;padding:11px 14px;background:#0c1c2b;border:1px solid #526a7d;border-radius:10px;color:#f4efe7}.setup-card input::placeholder{color:#7f91a0}.setup-card input[type=date]{color-scheme:dark}.team-field label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.team-field .team-dot{width:8px;height:8px}
.courts-field{margin-top:21px}.setup-card .setup-courts{display:flex;max-width:460px;gap:9px}.setup-courts button{flex:1;padding:10px 6px;font-size:13px;background:#102638;color:#c7d4dc;border-color:#4b5f72;border-radius:10px;font-weight:650;min-width:0}.setup-courts button.selected{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#756145,#4a4031);border-color:#e5c08e;color:#fff2d9;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff26}
.setup-actions{display:flex;margin-top:27px}.setup-actions .primary{padding:13px 20px;min-height:48px;flex:none;margin-left:auto;letter-spacing:.045em}.setup-actions button.ghost{background:transparent;border-color:#506071;color:#d0c5b8}.setup-next-hint{text-align:right;margin:8px 0 0;color:#8a9fac;font-size:10px}
.setup-format-grid{margin:14px 0}.format-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;background:#0d2435;border:1px solid #38576a;border-radius:12px;padding:17px 12px;margin-top:17px}.format-summary span{text-align:center;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.format-summary b{font-size:23px;color:#e8d2ae;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.format-summary small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#9db0bb}.colors-advanced{margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #374e61;padding-top:15px}.colors-advanced summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#cbd6dc}.colors-advanced summary span{float:right;color:#93a4b0;font-size:10px}.colors-advanced .grid2{padding:13px 0}.colors-advanced .team-identity label{font-size:11px}
.roster-team-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:14px 0}.roster-team-tab{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:normal;background:#102638;border-color:#3d5a72;color:#c4d2da}.roster-team-tab.active{background:#25384a;border-color:var(--team-accent);color:#fff4e8;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--team-accent) 24%,transparent)}.roster-registration-list{border:1px solid #3d586f;border-left:3px solid var(--team-accent);background:rgba(9,26,42,.72);border-radius:13px;padding:18px 20px}.roster-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#e8d3b1;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:14px}.roster-label small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em}
.roster-registration-list .pair-row{margin:9px 0;grid-template-columns:33px repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.roster-registration-list .pair-number{background:rgba(24,43,60,.8);color:#d9b37d}.roster-registration-list .pair-row input{min-width:0}
@media(max-width:700px){.wrap{padding:11px}.brand-banner{height:160px;padding:16px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;border-radius:14px;align-items:center}.brand-logo{width:55px;height:61px;border-radius:10px}.hero-heading{gap:11px}.brand-banner h1{font-size:clamp(19px,5vw,27px);letter-spacing:.065em;max-width:165px}.hero-right{position:absolute;top:11px;right:12px;gap:8px}.hero-right .signature{display:none}.hero-right .pill{font-size:9px;padding:4px 8px}.hero-sub{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.11em}.global-dock{margin-bottom:12px}.global-dock summary{padding:8px 11px}.setup-card{padding:18px 15px 15px;border-radius:15px}.setup-progress{margin-bottom:21px}.setup-progress-step{font-size:9px;gap:4px;padding:8px 2px}.setup-header{margin-bottom:20px;gap:8px}.setup-header h2{font-size:24px}.setup-header p{font-size:11px}.setup-status{font-size:9px;padding:5px 6px}.setup-simple-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.setup-simple-fields .field:nth-child(n){grid-column:auto}.setup-card input,.setup-card select{min-height:45px}.courts-field{margin-top:19px}.setup-card .setup-courts{max-width:none;gap:7px}.setup-courts button{min-height:45px}.setup-actions .primary{flex:1;padding:12px 10px}.setup-next-hint{text-align:center}.format-summary b{font-size:21px}.roster-registration-list{padding:12px 9px}.roster-registration-list .pair-row{grid-template-columns:25px repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.roster-registration-list .pair-row input{font-size:12px;padding:8px}.roster-label{font-size:13px}}

@media print{.brand-banner{display:none!important}}

/* v0.4.1 — Match Format belongs with initial session setup */
.setup-home-format{max-width:calc(50% - 10px);margin-top:18px}
.setup-current-format{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px;border-left:2px solid #917759;padding:8px 15px;background:rgba(14,35,51,.55);border-radius:5px}
.setup-current-format span{font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#ceb28b}
.setup-current-format b{color:#f2ede3;font-size:17px;font-weight:700}
.setup-current-format small{color:#9db0ba;font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:700px){.setup-home-format{max-width:none;margin-top:14px}.setup-current-format{min-height:72px}.setup-format-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* v0.4.2 · Minimal master-style home: no menu or numbered setup navigation. */
.setup-card{padding-top:25px}
.setup-header{margin-bottom:23px}
.setup-header .over{font-size:10px;color:#d2b68e;letter-spacing:.16em}
.setup-header h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px);margin:8px 0 0}
@media(max-width:700px){.setup-card{padding-top:20px}.setup-header{margin-bottom:22px}.setup-header h2{font-size:24px}}

/* TEAM SHOWDOWN v0.5 — Stage 1 Master-parity pass. No home or match-engine changes. */
.stage1-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.24fr) minmax(345px,.76fr);align-items:start;gap:14px}
.stage1-layout>.stage1-main,.stage1-layout>.stage1-sidebar{min-width:0}
.match-center{border-color:#52616c;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(27,39,49,.96),rgba(18,32,43,.96));padding:17px 17px 15px}
.match-center-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.match-center-head .over{color:#d9b68a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em}
.match-center-head h2{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.035em;margin:6px 0 5px;color:#f4ece2}
.match-center-sub{font-size:11px;color:#aebcc7;margin:0}
.round-progress-pill{flex:none;align-self:center;border:1px solid #6f5c44;border-radius:50px;background:#3b362f;color:#eccfa8;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.07em;padding:7px 9px;white-space:nowrap}
.round-progress-pill.done{border-color:#446955;color:#bce4c8;background:#243e33}
.round-progress-track{height:4px;background:#2f404c;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.round-progress-track>div{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#907352,#dabb89);transition:width .25s ease}
.round-overview{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:28px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:10px;color:#9bb1bd;letter-spacing:.015em}
.jump-leaderboard,.jump-scores{display:none}
.round-selector{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:0 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #43515a;margin-bottom:13px}
.round-selector .round-chip{position:relative;flex:0 0 36px;min-width:36px;height:35px;padding:0;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #50606c;background:#1b2e3f;color:#c5d1d7;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.round-selector .round-chip.complete:not(.selected){border-color:#4f7962;color:#a8d7b8}
.round-selector .round-chip.selected{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#91734d,#6c533c);color:#fff7e7;border-color:#d8b785;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #0003}
.round-chip .wave-check{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-3px;background:#1a3c2e;border:1px solid #58866d;border-radius:50%;width:13px;height:13px;color:#c3eed2;font-size:9px;line-height:11px}
.match-center .court-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(235px,1fr));gap:10px}
.match-center .court{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#192b38,#111e29);border:1px solid #637181;padding:13px 13px 10px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff0b;min-width:0}
.match-center .court.finished-court{border-color:#526f5d;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#172d31,#142430)}
.court-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff13;padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:9px}
.court-header>strong{color:#e7c296;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.10em}
.court-status{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.055em;color:#9eabb7;font-weight:700;text-align:right;max-width:60%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.court-status.court-done{color:#a2d9af}
.match-center .scorepairs{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 13px minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px}
.match-center .scorepair .pairname{min-height:54px;gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.match-center .scorepair .pairname strong{line-height:1.24;font-size:11px;color:#f0f1f0;font-weight:700;display:block;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.match-center .scorepair .pairname small{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:#a6b5c0}
.match-center .scorepair .team-dot{height:6px;width:6px;flex:0 0 6px}
.court-score-separator{font-size:23px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;margin-top:74px;text-align:center;color:#ccbdab}
.match-center .court-score-input{display:block;margin:8px auto 3px;width:100%;max-width:126px;height:58px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--team-accent) 45%,#405065);border-radius:10px;background:#0b1824;color:#fff8ed;font-size:32px;font-weight:750;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;padding:7px 2px;text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 8px #0003;appearance:textfield;-moz-appearance:textfield}
.match-center .court-score-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button,.match-center .court-score-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none;margin:0}
.match-center .court-score-input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--team-accent);outline-offset:1px}
.match-center .court-score-input::placeholder{color:#667786}
.court-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;min-height:20px}
.match-center .court-footer .scorehint{text-align:left;margin:0;line-height:1.3;font-size:10px;color:#aabac3}
.clear-score{flex:none;background:transparent;border:1px solid #4b6171;color:#c3cdd3;padding:4px 9px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;border-radius:7px;font-weight:600}
.round-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:15px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid #43515a}
.round-footer button{padding:10px 11px;font-size:11px;min-height:39px}
.round-footer span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#a0b3c0;text-align:center}
.stage1-controls{padding:15px 17px}
.stage1-controls .stage-label{margin:0 0 5px}
.stage1-controls h3{font-size:11px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.09em}
.stage1-pending{font-size:11px;color:#adbec9;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.stage-complete{color:#b7dec2;font-size:12px}
.stage1-rules{padding:13px 16px;box-shadow:none}
.stage1-rules summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#c8d0d6;font-weight:700}
.stage1-rules p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
.leaderboard-card{scroll-margin-top:14px}
.stage1-layout .unified-table td{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:970px){.stage1-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stage1-layout .stage1-main,.stage1-layout .stage1-sidebar{width:100%}}
@media(max-width:700px){.match-center{padding:13px 12px}.match-center-head h2{font-size:18px}.match-center-sub{font-size:10px}.round-progress-pill{font-size:9px;padding:6px 8px}.round-overview{padding-top:2px}.round-selector{gap:5px}.round-selector .round-chip{flex-basis:33px;min-width:33px;height:34px}.match-center .court-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.match-center .court{padding:12px 12px 9px}.match-center .scorepair .pairname{min-height:47px}.match-center .scorepair .pairname strong{font-size:12px}.court-score-separator{margin-top:66px}.match-center .court-score-input{height:54px;font-size:31px}.round-footer button{padding:9px 8px;font-size:10px;min-height:39px}.round-footer span{font-size:9px}.jump-leaderboard,.jump-scores{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;padding:4px 6px;border:none;background:none;color:#e5c39a;white-space:nowrap}.jump-scores{margin-left:auto}.rank-note:has(.jump-scores){display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}}
@media(max-width:370px){.round-progress-pill{font-size:8px}.match-center-head h2{font-size:17px}.round-footer button{font-size:9px}}

/* 0.6 · court-availability match engine, compact Match Control-style administration */
.global-dock{justify-content:flex-end;margin:6px 0 15px}.global-dock details{margin-left:auto}.global-dock summary{min-width:150px;text-align:center}.menu-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.menu-grid button[id="shareResults"]{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#826440,#b39169);border-color:#dec196;color:#15191d}
.match-center{background:linear-gradient(143deg,#24303a,#1b252d);border:1px solid #4c555d}.stage1-layout .leaderboard-card{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#28323b,#202b34)}
.match-center .court-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(225px,1fr));gap:9px}.match-center .court{background:#202d38;border:1px solid #887052}.court-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.live-court .court-status{color:#9bd0ac}.match-center .court-complete{margin:8px 0 1px;flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 10px;font-size:10px}.match-center .court-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.match-center .court-footer .scorehint{text-align:left}.waiting-court{border-style:dashed!important;border-color:#58636d!important;min-height:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.waiting-court .court-status{color:#deb881}.waiting-court-message{text-align:center;color:#9aa6af;font-size:13px;padding:12px}.live-queue{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 5px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid #3e4852;color:#aab5bc;font-size:11px}.match-history{background:#151f29;border:1px solid #3c4a56;border-radius:12px;padding:10px}.match-history summary{cursor:pointer;color:#d7bf9d;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.025em;font-size:12px}.history-scroll{max-height:310px;overflow:auto;margin-top:9px}.history-table td,.history-table th{padding:8px 5px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.history-table td:last-child button{padding:5px 8px;font-size:10px}.round-progress-pill{letter-spacing:.025em}.match-center .court-score-input{border-color:#8e785b;background:#131c25;color:#f6ebd9}
@media(max-width:700px){.match-center .court-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.match-center .court-footer{align-items:center}.match-center .court-complete{font-size:10px}.live-queue{flex-wrap:wrap}.waiting-court{min-height:108px}.history-scroll{overflow:auto}.global-dock details{width:auto}.menu-grid{width:min(350px,91vw)}}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
 TEAM SHOWDOWN v0.7 · MATCH CONTROL 4.8.92.18 VISUAL CONVERGENCE
 Original dashboard: charcoal/navy luxury, champagne highlights,
 translucent panels, compact single-line fixed partner registration.
 Tournament engine remains independently scoped to TEAM SHOWDOWN.
 ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
:root{--bg:#11171d;--card:#222b33;--card2:#29323a;--line:#46525a;--gold:#d5c2a1;--light:#f5f1e9;--muted:#aeb9c1;--good:#a8d8bd}
html{background:#0b1219}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% -12%,rgba(44,76,105,.40),transparent 55%),linear-gradient(180deg,#121d28 0%,#0b151e 55%,#09121a 100%);color:var(--light)}
.wrap{max-width:1500px;padding:20px 24px 40px}
/* Master compact header: real logo on a dark luxury masthead, not a large photo banner. */
.brand-banner.master-brand{height:auto;min-height:116px;padding:19px 26px;align-items:center;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(112deg,rgba(30,40,49,.96),rgba(24,33,41,.98) 64%,rgba(23,30,37,.98));border:1px solid rgba(212,183,138,.19);box-shadow:0 18px 44px #060a0d3b;margin-bottom:12px}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-scrim{display:none}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-heading{gap:18px}
.brand-banner.master-brand .brand-logo{height:76px;width:65px;background-color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px #0004)}
.brand-banner.master-brand h1{font-size:clamp(26px,2.75vw,38px);letter-spacing:.055em;line-height:1.10;margin:5px 0 6px;text-shadow:none;font-weight:680}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-sub{color:#aebbc3;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:9px}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-right{align-self:center;gap:12px}
.brand-banner.master-brand .hero-right .signature{font-size:10px;color:#bfc7cd}
.global-dock{margin:4px 0 13px;align-items:center}
.global-dock details{background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(36,46,55,.97),rgba(24,33,42,.97));border-color:#52616c;min-width:184px}
.global-dock summary{padding:11px 15px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750}
.menu-grid{background:#202b34;border:1px solid #6d675d;box-shadow:0 25px 55px #000a;z-index:20}
.menu-grid button{background:#28343e;border-color:#596570}
.menu-grid button[id="shareResults"]{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#6b5438,#bc9870);border-color:#dac097;color:#15191d}
.card{background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(44,55,64,.86),rgba(27,37,46,.89) 90%);border:1px solid rgba(111,126,138,.5);border-radius:17px;padding:18px 19px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #00000022;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.card h2{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.stage1-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(330px,.85fr);gap:18px}
/* Visual session identity above two-column match + leaderboard, as in master. */
.p5-stage-head{margin-bottom:12px}
.p5-si-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(37,48,57,.95),rgba(27,38,47,.92));border:1px solid #6a6154;border-radius:15px;padding:14px 18px;box-shadow:0 10px 27px #0003}
.p5-si-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.p5-si-identity{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,1.25fr) minmax(130px,1fr) minmax(130px,1fr);gap:17px;flex:1}
.p5-si-identity-cell{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding-right:14px;border-right:1px solid #5b6060}
.p5-si-identity-cell:last-child{border-right:0}
.p5-si-identity-cell span{color:#bd9b70;font-weight:740;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em}
.p5-si-identity-cell strong{color:#f4eee6;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.p5-si-status{padding:7px 13px;flex:none}
.p5-si-details{border-top:1px solid #515b62;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px 17px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;color:#d5d6d3;font-size:11px}
.p5-si-details span b{font-weight:700;color:#bd9b70;margin-right:5px}
.master-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:0 0 12px}
.master-stats .stat{background:rgba(34,46,55,.81);border:1px solid #46515a;padding:11px;border-radius:10px}
.master-stats .stat strong{font-size:23px;color:#eac99c}
.master-stats .stat small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.09em}
